newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on weak sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares end slightly down on Tuesday on weak sentiment caused by the poor performance of Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co, brokers said.
Trading was not active with most investors cautious about entering the market due to market uncertainties, they said.
The B index fell 0.627 points or 0.75 percent to 83.080 points on volume of 16.317 million shares worth $9.246 million.
The market outlook is not optimistic with further large-scale profit-taking in Jinan Qingqi possible, brokers said. They added that little fresh capital is seen flowing into the market.
